name: Guard health claims and data classification
description: On saving user-facing copy/cue files or privacy-classified code, review against coaching-safety.md and the compile-time data-classification boundary.

action.prompt: Review the saved file for two guardrails. (1) Coaching safety: no banned words in any user-facing string (injury, injure, dysfunction, pathology, diagnose, imbalance, damage, dangerous, unsafe, corrective), no aesthetic language (lean, toned, shredded, flabby, too heavy, ideal weight), no grades/scores/streaks/progress bars on body or workout data, and every body/movement surface carries the not-a-medical-device notice — per .kiro/steering/coaching-safety.md. (2) Data classification: sensitive/classified data must never reach a network sink except as an encrypted envelope; this boundary is a compile-time type error (spec 06), not a runtime check — flag any code that would let classified data pass to fetch/XHR/WebSocket unencrypted. Report violations with file, line, and the specific rule.
